target_customer: Marketing, sales and customer success teams without professional design skills
problem: Collecting customer testimonials and turning long video into short clips for marketing was slow and needed editing skills. Milk Video let users collect video through a link and clip it quickly.
product_category: Video marketing and testimonial collection software

founders.name: Ross Cranwell
founders.background_notes: YC page: 20+ years leading marketing and product innovation in New York and Shanghai, no employers named. Silicon Republic calls him a Dublin native.

founders.name: Leonard Bogdonoff
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no bio; Silicon Republic names Lenny Bogdonoff as CTO.

technical_complexity.rationale: Link-based video capture, clipping and captioning are standard web and media engineering for a two-person team in 2021.

defensibility.rationale: Several testimonial and video capture tools existed and the feature set was easy to copy; no sourced data or integration moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not copied by an incumbent per sources; Oktopost, a B2B social marketing vendor, acquired the company in June 2025.

market_need_then: Silicon Republic (Aug 2021) described demand from marketing, sales and customer success teams lacking design skills to make short video. No spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Used milkvideo.com; Samsung also had an unrelated Milk Video service (shut down November 2015), which clutters search results.
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt listing exists; no evidence of community or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with Samsung's defunct Milk Video; no sourced brand assets or press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Milk Video raised a roughly $1.5M seed in August 2021 led by Y Combinator and Dharmesh Shah and built a short-form video testimonial tool for marketers. YC lists it as inactive and says the CEO recently sold it, and Oktopost announced its acquisition in June 2025. No source explains how much traction it had or whether the sale was a soft landing, so the cause of the outcome is not public.
notes: milkvideo.com fetch returned HTTP 429, so the live site was not read. Acquisition reported by Demand Gen Report and CB Insights (dated June 2025), the Demand Gen page itself returned 403 on fetch and was only seen in search results. CB Insights total is $1.63M over 5 rounds versus the $1.5M seed, so about $0.13M of earlier rounds is unaccounted for. startupintros lists $2M and Latka claims bootstrapped, both conflicting. No dated competitors found: Silicon Republic named none directly, only adjacent Salesforce video and YouTube Shorts; competitor lists seen were undated. Status conflict: YC shows Inactive while the company was acquired.
